tests.check-typecheck-tests: pass: no errors outside the quarantine, no stale entries

learnings: tsconfig.tests.json has checkJs:false, so .mjs JSDoc is read only as the type of imports; widening or adding @typedef in an .mjs cannot create errors inside the .mjs itself, only at test call sites.
ledger.mjs returned Promise<object>, which made every property read in tests an error; a LedgerItem/Ledger @typedef in the module was the real fix, not casts in the test.

Under exactOptionalPropertyTypes, a JSDoc optional property the module already tolerates as undefined (reconcile edges, workers classifyWorker logsHash) must say `| undefined` explicitly or tests passing undefined fail.
Test-local .ts imports need an explicit .js extension under nodenext resolution (./workers-fixtures.js), matching ./support/cli-harness.js.
For noUncheckedIndexedAccess on fixture rows, a small throw-if-missing helper (rowOf, present) keeps the type honest and fails loudly instead of silently testing null.
In zsh, a space-separated file list in a scalar variable is not word-split; use an array for multi-file lint invocations.
